app.title: Pío · Learning to feel, one day at a time

common.noPermission: You don't have permission to make this change.

login.title: Hello, teacher!
login.subtitle: Sign in with the email from your invitation.
login.sideText: See how your class feels, assign the weekly lesson and support whoever needs it.

errors.notConfirmed: First accept the invitation sent to your email.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts in a row. Please wait a moment.
errors.generic: We couldn't sign you in. Check your connection and try again.
errors.noAccess: This account has no access to the portal.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: We'll send a link to your email.
forgot.sent: If that email is registered in Pío, you'll get a link to create a new password. Check your spam folder too.
forgot.tooSoon: You asked for a link a moment ago. Please wait a few minutes.

setPassword.invalidLink: The link is not valid or was already used.
setPassword.expiredLink: The link expired (it lasts 24 hours) or was already used.
setPassword.askInviteAgain: Ask your school's principal to invite you again, or
setPassword.inviteSubtitle: Create your password to enter the portal.
setPassword.same: That's already your password. Choose a different one.
setPassword.weak: Choose a stronger password: at least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
setPassword.generic: We couldn't save the password. Please try again.

noAccess.title: This account has no access to the portal
noAccess.text: The portal is for teachers, principals and counselors.

profile.title: Me
profile.languageHint: Saved in your account. Your students' lessons use each group's language.
profile.partial: Translation in progress: what is not yet in Miskitu shows in Spanish.

admin.subtitle: Program schools and lesson catalog.
admin.name: Name
admin.activeHint: An inactive school is left out of the program totals
admin.onlyAdmin: Only the admin team can do this.
admin.saveError: We couldn't save the school. Check the details.

alerts.subtitleTeacher: Students who might need a conversation with you.
alerts.subtitleSchool: Cases from the whole school. Risk alerts come first.
alerts.disclaimer: Alerts point to cases for a conversation. They are not a diagnosis.
alerts.updateError: Couldn't update. Reload the page and try again.
alerts.confirmClose: Close the alert? Do it once you have talked with the student.

streak.title: Might need support
streak.detail: Marked difficult emotions on {{days}} of the last {{window}} days.
streak.advice: Find a moment alone to ask how they are. Listen without judging; you don't need to solve anything right then.

help.titleCounselor: Asked to talk with the counselor
help.titleTeacher: Asked to talk with their teacher
help.detail: Tapped “I want to talk to someone” in the app.
help.advice: Reply today if you can, even just to agree on a time. Let them know their request arrived.

chat.title: Risk situation
chat.detail: Detected in the “Pío listens” chat. The conversation is not shown to anyone.
chat.advice: Follow the counseling protocol: talk with the student today and contact the family according to the UNICEF/MINED protocol.

referral.title: The teacher asked for counseling support
referral.detail: From a classroom observation · {{category}}. The observation text stays with the teacher.
referral.advice: Coordinate with the teacher a time to talk with the student.

assign.title: Assign lesson
assign.notFound: We couldn't find that lesson for this group.
assign.dueHint: Class on {{date}}. It shows up in the student's “My week”.
assign.messagePlaceholder: Hi everyone! This week we're practicing…
assign.notifyFamiliesHint: The home challenge appears on the group's QR page
assign.remindHint: Only to those who haven't finished, never at night

errors.duplicate: This lesson is already assigned to this group.
errors.dates: The due date can't be before the class.
errors.messageLength: The message can have at most 280 characters.
errors.permission: You don't have permission to assign in this group.
errors.generic: We couldn't assign the lesson. Check your connection and try again.

catalog.subtitle: Status of the structure and content by language. Content is loaded with tested migrations.

chat.title: “Pío listens” chat
chat.confirm: Turn on the chat for {{group}}? Only students with family consent who accept the terms can use it. If Pío detects a risk, it notifies the counselor and the principal; nobody reads the conversations.
chat.error: Couldn't change it. Only the principal can do this.

climate.title: How the group felt
climate.hidden: Shown once at least {{min}} students do their check-in this week, so nobody can be identified.

errors.ALREADY_SUBMITTED_IN_APP: The family already filled in this sheet in the app. Theirs is kept.
errors.LESSON_NOT_ASSIGNED: This lesson isn't assigned to this student.
errors.NOT_FOR_LEVEL: The family sheet is only for primary.
errors.COMMENT_TOO_LONG: The comment can have at most 280 characters.
errors.permission: You don't have permission for this student.

families.consentHint: The family gives or withdraws consent from the app, in “Family space”.
families.secondary: Secondary has no family sheet: the family sees participation and challenges, never personal content.
families.loadError: We couldn't load the families' data.
families.emotionOptional: Optional: if the sheet doesn't say, leave it unmarked.

family.how1: Listen without judging: every feeling is okay.
family.how2: Avoid phrases like “don't cry” or “that's nothing”.
family.how3: It takes 5 to 10 minutes, no pressure. If not today, another day.
family.how4: If you notice distress that lasts several days, let the teacher know.
family.sheet: The weekly sheet is filled in the app, in “Family space”.
family.none: There is no challenge yet this week. Come back after the next class.
family.notFound: This link no longer works. Ask the teacher for the new code.
family.error: We couldn't load the page. Check the connection and try again.
family.privacy: This page doesn't ask for or store any family data.

familyQr.error: We couldn't prepare this group's QR.
familyQr.localTitle: This QR points to this computer
familyQr.localText: and won't open on a phone. To test it with a phone, see the W7.8 note.
familyQr.step1: Open the phone camera and point it at the code.
familyQr.step2: Each week you'll see the home challenge and a note to support your child.
familyQr.step3: It takes 5 to 10 minutes, no pressure.
familyQr.privacy: No account needed. This page doesn't ask for or store any data about your family.

groupForm.noSchool: Your account isn't linked to a school.
groupForm.gradeHint: For now Pío has lessons for these two grades.
groupForm.weekdayHint: Pío suggests each lesson's due date based on this day.
groupForm.languageHint: Used for the lessons and the families' page. Each student can change their own in the app.

errors.duplicate: There is already a group with that grade and section in your school this year.
errors.rules: Check the details: something doesn't follow the group rules.
errors.generic: We couldn't save the group. Try again.

groups.title: My groups
groups.subtitle: The class code is what your students type to enter the app.

guide.title: Lesson guide
guide.beforeEmpty: The detailed guide for this lesson is being prepared. Meanwhile, use the content and what to observe in each mini-game, which come from the unit plan.
guide.gamesNote: In progress, each indicator shows as Achieved · In progress · Needs support. There are never grades.
guide.privateNote: Private step: what the student writes or draws there never leaves their phone.
guide.homeEmpty: This lesson's home challenge is being prepared.

stepKind.application: I use it in my life

plan.noWeekday: This group has no class day. Set it in Groups → Edit to see the plan.
plan.freeWeek: Free week: review or classroom activity
plan.hintStart: Remind your students to do the start-of-month self-assessment in the app.
plan.hintEnd: Last class: end-of-month self-assessment in the app.
plan.otherText: They were assigned on another class date (for example, before the day was changed).

progress.title: Progress
progress.loadError: We couldn't load this task's progress.
progress.noneDone: Nobody has finished this lesson yet.
progress.emotionNote: The emotion is the latest check-in of the week. Only you can see it.
progress.remindError: We couldn't send the reminder. Try again.
progress.noIndicators: This lesson has no mini-games with an indicator.

remind.queued_one: Done: we reminded 1 student. It arrives between 7:00 a.m. and 7:00 p.m.

remind.already_other: {{count}} already got a reminder in the last 12 hours.

remind.withoutApp_other: {{count}} haven't opened the app yet, so it can't reach them.

questions.anonTitle: Questions are anonymous: Pío doesn't store who wrote them, or when.
questions.anonText: Answer them in class for the whole group. If one worries you, talk with the counselor and address the topic with the group, without trying to find out who wrote it.
questions.secondaryOnly: The anonymous question box is for secondary.
questions.loadError: We couldn't load the question box.

empty.answered: You haven't marked any questions as answered yet.

report.excelScale: Qualitative scale: Achieved · In progress · Needs support. Pío doesn't use numeric grades; indicators support the teacher's observation.
report.privacy: This file contains students' names and results. Store it and share it only with whoever needs it.
report.title: End-of-month report
report.privacyScreen: This report has your students' names and results. Store it and share it only with whoever needs it.
report.scale: Qualitative scale: Achieved · In progress · Needs support. Pío doesn't use numeric grades. Indicators support the teacher's observation; they don't replace it.

school.title: My school
school.noSchoolTitle: Your account isn't linked to a school yet
school.noSchoolText: Ask the admin team to add you.
school.overviewError: We couldn't load the school dashboard.
school.privacy: This dashboard only shows numbers and totals. Names appear only in Alerts, for whoever has to handle each case.

sheet.title: Family sheet
sheet.hint: For families without a phone: print one per student. When they return it, enter it in Groups → Families → “Record paper sheet”.
sheet.noHome: The teacher will tell you this week's challenge.
sheet.q1: Did you do the home challenge?
sheet.q2: Which emotion did your child mention? (if any)
sheet.footer: Listen without judging: all emotions are okay. It takes 5 to 10 minutes, no pressure. Return this sheet to the teacher. Don't write phone numbers or addresses.

staff.subtitle: Who uses Pío in your school.
staff.inviteHint: They get an email to create their password.

student.title: Student record
student.privacy: Only you can see these notes. Not the student, their family or the principal. If you ask for support, the counselor gets a notice with the category, not your text.
student.placeholder: What you observed, in concrete words. For example: “Today they didn't want to join the game and stayed apart at recess.”
student.referText: The counselor gets an alert with the student's name and the category.
student.alertOpen: There was already an open support request for this student.
student.referred: You asked the counselor for support
student.confirmDelete: Delete this observation? This can't be undone.

errors.DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The date has to be between today and the last 60 days.
